thesis: Assess how Home Slice Pizza (1415 S Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78704) ranks across 1,249 shared search origins in a 10-mile radius (0.5-mile spacing, top-30 organic depth, search_this_area=false) for four core search themes: pizza restaurant, new york style pizza, pizza by the slice, and pizza takeout.
objectives: Measure top-3 and top-10 organic Maps visibility across 1,249 shared origins (10-mile radius, 0.5-mile grid spacing) for four distinct customer search themes.
Compare category discovery (pizza restaurant) against style-specific (new york style pizza), format-specific (pizza by the slice), and fulfillment-specific (pizza takeout) searches.
Distinguish genuine visibility drop-offs from Austin sister-location handoffs (More Home Slice at 1421 S Congress Ave and North Loop at 501 E 53rd St).
Identify ranks 4-10 strike zones where targeted website and profile clarity can be evaluated.
next_actions: Inspect the 216 near-miss origins (ranks 4-10) on pizza takeout (q4) in the Companion Campaigns view and compare the 1415 S Congress Ave profile against More Home Slice (1421 S Congress Ave).
Review the 240 near-miss origins on pizza restaurant (q1), 474 on new york style pizza (q2), and 482 on pizza by the slice (q3) along South Lamar, Zilker, East Austin, and Mueller.
Open the Keyword Stuffing tab in the Companion to inspect the 79 source-reviewed competitor titles and their 0-5 evidence confidence scores.
missing_evidence: Search rankings measure organic Google Maps visibility at sampled coordinates; they do not measure walk-in traffic, online ordering conversions, or revenue.

Two queries (new york style pizza and pizza takeout) each had 1 origin out of 1,249 where the provider returned fewer than 30 organic listings after retry; those 2 observations are marked as incomplete absence rather than confirmed top-30 absence.

steps: Make direct online ordering and carry-out pickup instructions prominent above the fold on the South Congress location page.

steps: Treat northern frontier origins (beyond 4 miles north of Lady Bird Lake) as North Loop's primary catchment.
Run a dedicated North Loop center-point study before planning any North Austin local campaigns.
Ensure the main website Locations hub clearly routes North Austin searchers to 501 E 53rd St.

companion_intel.campaign_summary: Home Slice Pizza South Congress (1415 S Congress Ave) operates alongside its dedicated walk-up slice and takeout sister counter More Home Slice (1421 S Congress Ave) and its North Loop location (501 E 53rd St). The 10-mile open-search study shows how specialty style authority (new york style pizza) and slice discovery (pizza by the slice) extend farther across Austin than general category or takeout searches. Public ranking observations identify where sister profiles and neighborhood rivals trade places; they do not establish order volume, margin, or ranking causation.
companion_intel.campaign_recommendation: Prioritize the South Congress location-page content and carry-out pickup clarity within the 3-mile core, while letting North Loop (501 E 53rd St) serve North Austin neighborhoods.

name_review.policy_summary: Use the consistently represented real-world business name. Appended service descriptors (such as Slice Shop & Take Out), neighborhood modifiers, or host-venue tags require individual comparison against storefront signage and website branding before any edit is proposed.

flagged_cases.name: Pedroso's Pizza- Slice Shop & Take Out
flagged_cases.address: 2207 Justin Ln suite D, Austin, TX 78757
flagged_cases.confidence_rationale: Strong concern (4/5): Both the Justin Lane and Airport Blvd profiles append exact high-volume search phrases ("Slice Shop & Take Out") after a hyphen, whereas the official website brand is "Pedroso's Pizza". Physical storefront signage at 2207 Justin Ln still needs verification.
flagged_cases.finding: The Justin Lane Google Business Profile is titled "Pedroso's Pizza- Slice Shop & Take Out" and captures 124 first-place wins across the 10-mile Austin scan (including 51 wins for pizza by the slice and 24 for pizza takeout). The linked official website (pedrosospizza.com) titles the business "Pedroso's Pizza | Fresh 'n' Hot Square or Not" and uses "Pedroso's Pizza" as the primary brand name without appending "- Slice Shop & Take Out".
flagged_cases.counterevidence: The Justin Lane brick-and-mortar storefront operates as a slice shop and take-out counter, so physical window lettering or menu boards on site could display "Slice Shop & Take Out" alongside the Pedroso's Pizza logo.

flagged_cases.name: CraigO's Pizza & Pastaria & Salads
flagged_cases.address: 11215 S I-35 Frontage Rd, Austin, TX 78747
flagged_cases.confidence_rationale: Moderate concern (3/5): Website metadata and sister branches use "CraigO's Pizza & Pastaria" without the trailing "& Salads", though branch fascia signage could include menu descriptors.
flagged_cases.finding: This South I-35 branch is titled "CraigO's Pizza & Pastaria & Salads" (73 first-place wins), whereas the linked website metadata (craigositalian.com) and sister Austin branches use "CraigO's Pizza & Pastaria".
flagged_cases.counterevidence: Some individual CraigO's franchise or branch locations include "Salads" on building fascia signage.

flagged_cases.name: Tony C's Pizza & Beer Garden - Anderson Lane
flagged_cases.address: 2900 W Anderson Ln. Bldg B, Austin, TX 78757
flagged_cases.confidence_rationale: Moderate concern (3/5): "Tony C's Pizza & Beer Garden" is supported by concept branding, but the trailing "- Anderson Lane" branch modifier is a location suffix.
flagged_cases.finding: The profile is titled "Tony C's Pizza & Beer Garden - Anderson Lane" (36 first-place wins, including 30 on new york style pizza). The captured website metadata reads "Tony C's Beer Garden" and the title appends the street suffix "- Anderson Lane".
flagged_cases.counterevidence: Tony C's signage and menus use "Tony C's Pizza & Beer Garden", so "Pizza &" reflects real-world branding; only the trailing "- Anderson Lane" branch suffix is likely an added location modifier.

flagged_cases.name: CraigO's Pizza - Balcones
flagged_cases.confidence_rationale: Moderate concern (3/5): Appended "- Balcones" location suffix differs from the website brand "CraigO's Pizza & Pastaria".
flagged_cases.finding: The Balcones Dr profile appends a street/location modifier in "CraigO's Pizza - Balcones" (16 first-place wins), while the website brand is "CraigO's Pizza & Pastaria".
flagged_cases.counterevidence: Multi-location operators sometimes add a corridor name to distinguish branches, though Google guidelines generally discourage location suffixes unless part of consistent real-world signage.

flagged_cases.name: Niki's Pizza Italian & Greek cuisine
flagged_cases.confidence_rationale: Moderate concern (3/5): Appends cuisine category descriptors ("Italian & Greek cuisine") to "Niki's Pizza".
flagged_cases.finding: The profile is titled "Niki's Pizza Italian & Greek cuisine" (5 first-place wins on new york style pizza), whereas the website domain (nikipizza.com) and logo assets read "Niki Pizza".
flagged_cases.counterevidence: The website title tag reads "Niki Pizza | Austin Tech Ridge - Italian & Greek Cuisine", and strip-center fascia signage may include "Italian & Greek Cuisine" as a sub-line.

flagged_cases.name: Side Eye Pie @Meanwhile Brewery
flagged_cases.confidence_rationale: Limited concern (2/5): "@Meanwhile Brewery" is a factual host-venue indicator rather than commercial keyword stuffing, though Google's naming policy prefers using the Located-in attribute while keeping the title "Side Eye Pie".
flagged_cases.finding: The profile is titled "Side Eye Pie @Meanwhile Brewery" (78 first-place wins), while the linked website (sideeyepie.com) uses the concise brand name "Side Eye Pie".
flagged_cases.counterevidence: Side Eye Pie operates on the grounds of Meanwhile Brewing Co. at 3901 Promontory Point Dr; Google provides a separate "located in" attribute for host venues rather than requiring the host venue in the business title.

flagged_cases.name: Pedroso's Pizza- Slice Shop & Take Out
flagged_cases.confidence_rationale: Limited concern (2/5): Jev 1.14 optical recognition verified that the Airport Blvd GBP logo badge includes both "SLICE SHOP" and "AND TAKE OUT" in its arcs, though the website header uses "Pedroso's Pizza" and outdoor storefront signage is not visible in 2024 Street View.
flagged_cases.finding: The Airport Blvd profile (#9 in overall 10-mile visibility) is titled "Pedroso's Pizza- Slice Shop & Take Out" and wins 61 first-place slots (42 on pizza takeout and 16 on pizza by the slice). Jev 1.14 optical recognition (suspect_terms_shown 0.94) discovered that unlike the Justin Ln trailer logo ("TAKE OUT / AUSTIN TX"), the Airport Blvd GBP uploaded a different round logo badge whose top arc reads "SLICE SHOP" and bottom arc reads "AND TAKE OUT". However, the website header says "Pedroso's Pizza", and 2024 Street View of 3850 Airport Blvd shows the host bar exterior ("BAR" neon sign) without exterior Pedroso's storefront signage.
flagged_cases.counterevidence: Jev 1.14 optical inspection verified that the Airport Blvd GBP round logo badge prints "SLICE SHOP" in its upper arc and "AND TAKE OUT" in its lower arc, supporting both phrases as logo taglines even though exterior storefront signage is not yet visible in Street View.

flagged_cases.name: Brooklyn Pie Co. @ LaLa's South Pole
flagged_cases.confidence_rationale: Limited concern (2/5): Appends a host-venue suffix ("@ LaLa's South Pole") to the core brand "Brooklyn Pie Co.".
flagged_cases.finding: The Davis Lane profile is titled "Brooklyn Pie Co. @ LaLa's South Pole" (47 first-place wins), while brooklynpie.com brands the business as "Brooklyn Pie Co.".
flagged_cases.counterevidence: The trailer/kitchen is co-located at Lala's South Pole on Davis Ln, so the suffix describes the host bar rather than generic pizza keywords.

flagged_cases.finding: The profile title 'Allday Pizza: Tarrytown' is longer than the extracted website brand ('allday.pizza'), typically due to a branch or neighborhood suffix.
flagged_cases.counterevidence: Multi-location restaurant groups frequently append a shopping center or corridor name to branch listings.

flagged_cases.confidence_rationale: Limited concern (2/5): Appends "- Downtown Austin" location modifier while sister Austin profiles use "DeSano Pizzeria Napoletana".
